items.evidence: The log shows 19 µL master mix, 2.5 µL forward primer, 2.5 µL reverse primer and 1 µL template going into pcr_plate A1:G1, with templates A1,A1,B1,C1,A1,A1,D1 as specified, followed by the gradient PCR comment.

The log shows 19 µL water, 5 µL rCutSmart and 1 µL DpnI added to each of A1:G1, then a 30 µL mix. The 37/65°C incubation is recorded as a comment, and protocol.pause carries the Zymo clean-up instructions.
The log shows 7 µL water, 2 µL T4 buffer, 3 µL fragment 2, 2 µL fragment 5, 3 µL fragment 6 and 2 µL fragments 1, 3, 4 and 7 added to A1:D1, then 1 µL enzyme mix with a 5-cycle mix after dispensing.
Comments record the Golden Gate cycling (30 × 37/16°C, 60°C), the clean-up and the heat shock. The log shows 5 µL of each assembly moved into cells_plate A1:D1 and then 250 µL LB added to each well.
Every transfer uses new_tip='always', so the log shows a fresh tip for each destination and each fragment or assembly, and each mix uses its own tip. No tip is reused across wells.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly, and the run log matches every specified volume, source/destination pairing and step order. Manual steps are recorded as comments, and a fresh tip is used for every transfer, so all five items pass.
